# Checkout.com setup — Northwind Commerce (as of 2026-07-09, PRODUCTION)
# This describes THIS merchant's CKO configuration. Answer config questions against it.
# Where a fact is not listed and coverage is partial, say so rather than assuming.

BUSINESS: Online brokerage/trading. Full account, single entity. MCC 6211. Regions: IT, CY, AE, GB.

ENTITY: Northwind Commerce Ltd (ent_northwind_root), incorporated IT. Payments+payouts enabled.

PROCESSING CHANNELS:
- pc_it_main (IT): Visa+Mastercard; cur EUR/USD/GBP; MCC 6211; auto-capture ON; AUTH EXPIRY 7 days.
- pc_fr_cards (FR): Visa+Mastercard+Cartes Bancaires; cur EUR; MCC 6211; auto-capture OFF; AUTH EXPIRY 30 days.

SCHEMES: Visa=on, Mastercard=on, Cartes Bancaires=on (FR only), Amex=OFF.
APMs: Apple Pay + Google Pay (IT/FR, EUR).

PAYOUTS: FT types FD=on, GP=off.
PAY-TO-CARD: enabled. Corridors: IT->AE (Visa,MC,FD), CY->AE (Visa,FD). MCC 6211.
  NOT configured: pay-to-card to US.
Payout destinations: card (AE,GB,IT), bank (IT,GB). Schedule daily T+1.

SETTLEMENT: net, daily, EUR+GBP. Reserve rolling 5% / 30d. Banks IT/EUR, GB/GBP.

RISK: 3DS risk-based, SCA exemption TRA. Network tokens on, Account Updater on, intelligent retries OFF. (coverage: partial)

INTEGRATION: Direct API, version 2023-11-01. Webhooks: payment_captured, payment_declined, payout_paid. (coverage: partial)

GAPS: no US pay-to-card; no Amex; no in-country USD acquiring.
